title: Told the Hour
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 123
medium: Interactive page (index.html): one hourly electricity-load record drawn as a dot plot at two sizes (300x90 and 40x12 pixels); a switch between the two sentences the makers were told about the dots, which swaps in the still works the makers of each sentence made; the record itself, with the makers' readings laid on it; a coded ledger and the predictions. A figure (figure.svg); reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Perceiving, with the account withheld. Makers given the same record at two grains, half of them told what a dot is and half not, recognised exactly what the grain let them measure. Those not told rebuilt the account from the picture's rhythm or the count. Recognition decided the name they gave the world, right where measured and wrong where supplied; it did not decide whether they filled the picture's margin.
project_step: Eighteenth experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with finding a form). Takes up experiment 17's open thread 1 (separate recognition from resolution) and thread 2 (exclude rulers in a question about what is drawn: coder A's A2 and A3). Keeps experiment 17's 300-pixel grain, render, rooms and blind coders, and adds the brief's account of the material as a second variable. Decides S122.RECOGNISE (falsified by both clauses). Works with and against the order-word and incorporeal transformation (ATP 76, 80-81) and the tracing (ATP 12-13), as Cartography, not Tracing gives them.
material: Energy-Charts (Fraunhofer ISE), public net electricity, Germany, series Load, 15-minute values 15 Nov 2025 - 15 Jan 2026 averaged to 1,464 hourly values, CC BY 4.0 (data: Energy-Charts.info), fetched 2026-10-13; domain: electricity demand
seed: prepare.py seed 123 (cells); coders.py seed 1231 (coder A's order); makers and coders are model instances and not seeded
